description: Kosovo Geoportal (national spatial data infrastructure) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Kosovo Cadastral Agency. Search summaries describe the geoportal as the common access point for the electronic services of the national spatial data infrastructure, run by the Kosovo Cadastral Agency, where users can search and read data held by the agency, with data from other providers possible. Coverage: Kosovo. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the page is drawn by script and returned only its title, so the layers, formats and licence are unknown and hazard data were not confirmed. It can support finding base geographic layers for Kosovo. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30 but its text could not be read; statements come from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
